configs.direct_off.yaml:
coordinate_system: polar
polar_domain:
  r_start: 0.0050633
  r_end: 0.1
  r_orientation: horizontal
  theta_range: 2*pi

    value: 0
  outer:

    value: 0

    type: periodic
    value: 1
